title: Ask, Answer, and Detect: Role-Playing LLMs for Personality Detection with Question-Conditioned Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2512.08814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding human personality is important for personalized recommendation and mental health assessment. Existing personality detection methods typically encode social media posts into user representations and predict personality labels. Despite advances in large language models (LLMs), these methods face limited supervision from scarce labels and an unclear mapping between user language and psychological constructs. We propose ROME, a framework that incorporates psychological knowledge into personality detection. Inspired by standardized self-assessment tests, ROME uses LLM role-playing to simulate users' responses to validated psychometric questionnaires. These question-level answers provide interpretable, questionnaire-grounded evidence and intermediate supervision. translated_title: 提问、回答与检测：基于问题条件化混合专家模型的角色扮演大语言模型人格检测
translated_abstract: 理解人类人格对个性化推荐和心理健康评估非常重要。现有人格检测方法通常将社交媒体帖子编码为用户表示并预测人格标签。尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了进展，这些方法仍面临标签稀缺导致的监督有限，以及用户语言与心理构念之间映射不清晰的问题。我们提出了ROME，一个将心理学知识融入人格检测的框架。受标准化自评测试的启发，ROME利用大语言模型角色扮演来模拟用户对经过验证的心理测量问卷的回答。这些问题级别的答案提供了可解释的、有问卷依据的证据和中间监督。一个问题条件化的混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）模块将帖子和问题表示进行联合路由，在显式监督下预测问卷答案。
tldr: 提出ROME框架，通过大语言模型角色扮演模拟用户回答心理测量问卷，并利用问题条件化混合专家模块提供可解释的中间监督，从而将心理学知识融入社交媒体人格检测。
en_tdlr: ROME is a framework that uses role-playing LLMs to simulate users' responses to validated psychometric questionnaires, with a question-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts module providing interpretable, questionnaire-grounded intermediate supervision for personality detection.
